In this video, I break down how something most people completely overlook turned into a real online business through Texas Snacks at https://texassnax.com , and why places like this quietly create massive opportunity around them. I talk about how demand actually forms, why entire ecosystems pop up around certain locations, and how a simple observation turned into a real way to make money. I keep the details intentionally light, but if you watch closely, you’ll start to see the opportunity hiding in plain sight.

Enjoy!
